name: Polaris Lance

frame.name: The Perfect Fifth
frame.description: Precision hits return ammo to the mag. Landing 4 precision hits loads a delayed Solar explosive round that scorches targets for your next shot.

perks.name: Smallbore
perks.description:
Dual strength barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Tactical Mag
perks.description:
This weapon has multiple tactical improvements.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases magazine size

perks.name: Zen Moment
perks.description: Causing damage with this weapon reduces recoil and flinch over time.

perks.name: Fitted Stock
perks.description:
This stock makes the weapon stable but heavy
  •  Increases stability
  •  Moderately controls recoil
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

flavor: "I've forgotten so much of my past life, of my family. But when I hold this rifle, everything feels right. I feel like… I'm home." —Ana Bray
